# ReturnMyTax

> US expat tax filing service specializing in Americans living in Israel, handling FBAR, FATCA, and cross-border taxation

## About

ReturnMyTax is a free us expat tax filing, fbar, fatca & cross-border taxation platform at [returnmytax.com](https://returnmytax.com). Founded in 2024.

- Specialized in US-Israel cross-border taxation
- Expert handling of FBAR, FATCA, and treaty provisions
- Trusted by American expats in Israel
- Up-to-date with latest IRS expat filing requirements

## Tools & Calculators

- [Tax Refund Estimator](https://returnmytax.com/tax-refund-calculator): Estimate your US tax refund from abroad
- [FBAR Filing Guide](https://returnmytax.com/fbar-guide): Step-by-step FBAR filing for US expats
- [FEIE Calculator](https://returnmytax.com/feie-calculator): Calculate your Foreign Earned Income Exclusion
- [Foreign Tax Credit Calculator](https://returnmytax.com/ftc-calculator): Calculate your Foreign Tax Credit on Form 1116
